content.short: Liker Land is the Web3 publisher and bookstore for writers.
content.description: Liker Land is a Web3 publisher and bookstore designed for writers. It enables readers and creators to read, own, create, and verify the integrity of public content through a creative business model. The platform connects readers and media sites to Web3, via WordPress plugins (w3press), enabling new approaches within existing publishing workflows. Writers and readers own their authorship, readership, and social graphs, participate in a more open royalties structure, co-create content, and support a durable, scalable creator economy.
